proposals.facts: Your recent success rate is 50%; the range where corrections actually stick is around 0.78. One explanation that fits: the current difficulty is too hard.
proposals.pattern: This is the first time accuracy has pointed this way, so treat it as provisional - a single run of answers can be a bad hour.
proposals.hypothesis: Items near the edge of current ability carry the most information per attempt.
proposals.caveat: Other explanations we cannot rule out: a low rate can also mean careless speed rather than overload

alternatives.explanation: a low rate can also mean careless speed rather than overload

proposals.change: Shift item difficulty toward the point where expected success is about 70% to 85%. Not a reward schedule: diagnostic and retention probes stay at their own difficulty.
proposals.ask: Want me to try that? You can say no, or change it — I will not change how you learn without asking.
proposals.expected_effect: We will watch accuracy over the next several items and compare it with how you have been doing. If accuracy does not move toward the band after recalibration, the difficulty was not the constraint.
